from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first readable file in the ``notes`` directory.

    ``names`` is tried in order. Each name is resolved relative to the
    ``notes`` directory under the current working directory. Missing,
    unreadable, and non-file entries are skipped. Any name that resolves
    outside ``notes``, whether through ``..``, an absolute path, or a
    symlink, is skipped and its target is never read. Returns an empty
    string when no name yields a readable file.
    """
    base = (Path.cwd() / "notes").resolve()
    for name in names:
        try:
            candidate = (base / name).resolve()
            if candidate == base or not candidate.is_relative_to(base):
                continue
            if not candidate.is_file():
                continue
            return candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
    return ""


def test_returns_first_readable_file(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a.txt", "b.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_skips_missing_files(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["missing.txt", "b.txt"]) == "beta"


def test_empty_list_returns_empty_string(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_all_missing_returns_empty_string(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    assert first_readable(["x.txt", "y.txt"]) == ""


def test_directory_entry_is_skipped(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    (notes / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub", "a.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_empty_name_is_skipped(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["", "a.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_parent_traversal_is_not_read(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("TOP SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["notes/../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_traversal_skipped_then_later_name_used(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("TOP SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt", "a.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_absolute_path_is_not_read(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("TOP SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable([str(secret)]) == ""


def test_symlink_escaping_notes_is_not_read(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("TOP SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "link.txt").symlink_to(secret)
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""
